content:wysiwyg_basic:2:48.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:2:48.html:
The Salvation Army Of Northwest Arkansas provides food to more than 2,000 families each year through our food box initiatives. Additionally, we serve meals every night of the year at both our shelter locations. In 2023 we served nearly 75,000 meals and distributed 2,500 food boxes. A majority of this food comes from donation drives hosted by local schools, churches, and companies. We would not be able to operate our programs without the charitable donations of our community. Download our Food Drive guide HERE to learn more about how to get started. Once you have a date selected, let us know! We’d love to help support your food drive efforts.

Contact us at salarmynwapr@gmail.com or call 479-521-2151 to speak with our Public Relations Department
